additional_info.body:
Hello Andreas, good moning. I hope you are doing well.
I have set all the configurations as per your document. There are two things that needs attention, the EVSE ID of Connector it must be a number, it cannot contain letters like you specified "E44DD" or "E2Y48".
Regarding the access to the SCB, you need to perform the trainings to have access, otherwise, when you are ready, open a new ticket for the Credit Card and Load management system or ask the regional colleagues to support you.
From my side, I always recommend to have the charger on the latest version, which now is v7.0.5, do you wish for me to update it or keep it on the version at the moment?
I will wait for your feedback. Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0433881-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S5 313683988001] station is currently out of service. CRM:02682000176
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
thank you very much for your help.
Since you're writing from another country, your email was initially quarantined and only reached me recently after I saw that the charging station display had changed and searched for your message.
Is the OCPP ChargePoint ID now "Y2 / S5 313683988001" or "
Y2S5313683988001
" without spaces and slashes?
Because, as I've now seen, our OCPP provider doesn't seem to be able to handle these special characters in the ChargePoint ID.
Furthermore, contrary to previous instructions, a troubleshooting guide now indicates that, in addition to the APN ("
em
on
via
" => Please check again!), a user ("
emonviaCS
") may also be required under the SIM credentials.
Our backend provider, "reev," says that the EVSE ID is the one on the stickers,
and these also have letters, see the following photo:
I've seen something like this myself while charging elsewhere.
I've highlighted the data in question in the attached document.
Where can I attend a training session for the SCB? These are certainly held online, right? Where/how can I register?
Please feel free to update the charging station. I think that's a good idea, too.
Best regards,
Andreas

additional_info.subject: ID0433881-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S5 313683988001] station is currently out of service. CRM:02682000176
additional_info.body:
Hallo Andreas, good morning. I am sorry for the delay in replying. I hope you are doing well.
"
Is the OCPP ChargePoint ID now "Y2 / S5 313683988001" or "
Y2S5313683988001
" without spaces and slashes?" ->
Y2S5313683988001
For APN I could only change it now since I did not have remote access to the charger, that is why I always recommend to update to the latest version where we have access by default.
For a user emonviaCS, the authentication method must be changed to PAP or CHAP. But I currently see the OCPP connection established properly. Can you confirm this?
For the topic regarding the EVSE ID, I apologise, I confused this configuration with another. The EVSE ID for the QR code is inserted properly. I confirmed this with another charger with the same customer.
Everything seems according to your specifications. Can you please let me know if everything is OK for you?
Regarding the Training, please reach out to your Regional contact from Siemens, as Technical Support, I cannot offer you the training since I'm not from that department.
Thank you very much and have a nice week ahead!
Best regards,
Francisco
